headline: Vimta Labs Limited files SEBI Takeover Disclosure under Regulation 31(4)
sum: Vimta Labs Limited has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations with NSE, signalling a substantial acquisition of shares or open offer event requiring regulatory transparency.
detail: Vimta Labs Limited, a listed testing and analytical laboratory services company, has submitted a formal disclosure to NSE in compliance with Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This disclosure is filed when an acquirer crosses a material shareholding threshold or announces an open offer. The specific parties, consideration, and percentage stake are subject to the detailed disclosure document filed with the exchange.
